title: #21. The Battle Of Badr Part 1
arabic:
اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَّ الشِّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ۝بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَانِ الرَّحِيْمَ۝

اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْراَ Allahعَزّوجَلّ says;

وَلَا تَكُونُوا كَالَّذِينَ خَرَجُوا مِنْ دِيَارِهِمْ بَطَرًا وَرِئَاءَ النَّاسِ وَرِئَاءَ النَّاسِ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ مُحِيطٌ۝

كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْقِتَالُ وَهُوَ كُرْهٌ لَكُمْ ۖ وَعَسَىٰ أَنْ تَكْرَهُوا شَيْئًا وَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ ۖ وَعَسَىٰ أَنْ تُحِبُّوا شَيْئًا وَهُوَ شَرٌّ لَكُمْ ۗ

وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ۝

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; وَعَسَىٰ أَنْ تَكْرَهُوا شَيْئًا وَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ ۖ يُجَادِلُونَكَ فِي الْحَقِّ بَعْدَمَا تَبَيَّنَ كَأَنَّمَا يُسَاقُونَ إِلَى الْمَوْتِ وَهُمْ يَنْظُرُونَ۝

اَلْقَوْمْ بَيْنَتْ ثَمِيْعَ وَالْاَلْفْ كُنَّا اَصْحَابَ مُحَمَّد نَتَحَدَّثُ اَنَّ عِدَّتَ اَصْحَابَ بَدْرٍ عَلَى عِدَّتِ اَصْحَا بِ طَالُوْطْ

اَلَّذِيْنَ جَاوَزُوهُمْ مَعَه’ نَهَرْ وَلَمْ يُجَاوِزُمَعَه’ اِلَّا مُؤمِنْ بِضْعَتَ عَشَرْ وَثَلَا ث  مِيْعَةْ Al-Habbab Ibn Munzir(ألحباب إبن اَلْمُنْذِر) one of Al-Ansaar رضي الله عنه,

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; إِذْ يُرِيكَهُمُ اللَّهُ فِي مَنَامِكَ قَلِيلًا ۖ وَلَوْ أَرَاكَهُمْ كَثِيرًا لَفَشِلْتُمْ لَفَشِلْتُمْ وَلَتَنَازَعْتُمْ فِي الْأَمْرِ وَلَٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ سَلَّمَ ۗ

إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ۝

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; إِذْ يُغَشِّيكُمُ النُّعَاسَ أَمَنَةً مِنْهُ وَيُنَزِّلُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَيُنَزِّلُ عَلَيْكُمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً لِيُطَهِّرَكُمْ بِهِ وَيُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمْ رِجْزَ الشَّيْطَانِ وَلِيَرْبِطَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِكُمْ وَيُثَبِّتَ بِهِ الْأَقْدَامَ۝

إذْ يُغَشِّيكُمُ النُّعَاسَ أَمَنَةً مِنْهُ كُسَالَىٰ يُرَاءُونَ النَّاسَ وَلَا يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ إِلَّا قَلِيلً إِذْ أَنْتُمْ بِالْعُدْوَةِ الدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ بِالْعُدْوَةِ الْقُصْوَىٰ وَالرَّكْبُ أَسْفَلَ مِنْكُمْ ۚ

وَلَوْ تَوَاعَدْتُمْ لَاخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِي الْمِيعَادِ ۙ وَلَٰكِنْ لِيَقْضِيَ اللَّهُ أَمْرًا كَانَ مَفْعُولًا۝

لِيَهْلِكَ مَنْ هَلَكَ عَنْ بَيِّنَةٍ وَيَحْيَىٰ مَنْ حَيَّ عَنْ بَيِّنَةٍ ۗ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَسَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ۝

Ibn Is'haqq(اِبْنِ اِسْحَاقْ) says; Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; وَإِذْ يُرِيكُمُوهُمْ إِذِ الْتَقَيْتُمْ فِي أَعْيُنِكُمْ قَلِيلًا وَيُقَلِّلُكُمْ فِي أَعْيُنِهِمْ

لِيَقْضِيَ اللَّهُ أَمْرًا كَانَ مَفْعُولًا ۗ وَإِلَى اللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ الْأُمُورُ۝

لِيَقْضِيَ اللَّهُ أَمْرًا كَانَ مَفْعُولًا ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الَّذِينَ يُقَاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِهِ صَفًّا صَفًّا كَأَنَّهُمْ بُنْيَانٌ مَرْصُوصٌ۝

يَا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ حَرِّضِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَى الْقِتَالِ ۚ إِنْ يَكُنْ مِنْكُمْ عِشْرُونَ صَابِرُونَ يَغْلِبُوا مِائَتَيْنِ ۚ وَإِنْ يَكُنْ مِنْكُمْ مِائَةٌ يَغْلِبُوا أَلْفًا مِنَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا

مِنَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمٌ لَا يَفْقَهُونَ۝

قُوْمُوْ اِلَى جَنَّتٍ اَرْضُهَا السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْاَرْضْ بخن بخن جَحَّدُوْ بِهَا وَسْتَيْقَنَتْهَا اَنْفُسُهُمْ اُمَيَّةْ رَاْسُ الْكُفْرْ يَا بِلَالْ

لَا نَجَوْتُ اِنْ نَجَا رحمه الله بلال إمام في الكفر إِنَّكَ لا تَهْدِي مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ وَلَكِنَّ اللَّهَ يَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ رِضَى بِقَدَرِ الله عَزُّواَجَلْ

رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ۝

وَصَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرًا وَالسلام عليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته
english:
The Life of Muhammadﷺ, The Madinan Period, Volume 1 By Imam Anwar Al_Awlaki, In the beginning we say, Al-Hamdolillah(ألحمدلله), Who is allowing us to live these moments, with the best of His creation, Muhammadﷺ,

it's such a great honor from Allahعَزّوجَلّ to allow us and give us that opportunity.

We're carrying on with Ghazwat Badr(غزوة البدر).

And we said that Abu Sufiyan(ابوسفيان) was very alert, he, himself was scouting the area and he passed next to the wells of Badr(بدر).

And he asked the people whom he saw there, who're drawing water from those wells.

He asked them, He said; Did you see anybody here, who's foreigner, whom you didn't distinguish.

They said: We saw two men here.

So, Abu Sufiyan(ابوسفيان) went to the place, where their camels were.

And he then held some of the camel manure in his hand, and he crushed it.

And he said, these camels have been feeding crushed date seeds, and that is the animal feed of Madina.

So he recognized that these two men came from Madina, and therefore he changed course.

And he rushed towards the coast and was able to evade the Muslims.

And then he sends a letter back to Makkah, and he said: "You came out to do battle in order to protect your caravan, people and wealth, Allah has now saved these, so go back."

Abu Sufiyan(ابوسفيان) said, there's no point now, in fighting, the caravan is safe.

So, go back.!

Abu Jahal(ابو جَهَل) said: "By Allah, we'll not turn around, until we reach Badr(بدر).

And Badr(بدر) was a place, where the Arabs would hold the fair and a market each year, they would gather in that place and hold a fair.

So, Abu Jahal(ابو جَهَل) went on, he said, we'll stay there three days slaughter some camels, eat well, drink wine, and the entertainers will play music for us.

The Bedouin will get to hear of our journey and of our gathering there.

And they will respect us for it.

Let us proceed ahead.

So, for Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل), it was a matter of flexing muscles.

We'll go there, we'll celebrate, we'll drink wine, we'll have the slave girls, sing for us, and let all the Arabs come and see the strength of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) and let them, fear us after that.

So, Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; And do not be like those, who came forth from their homes insolently, and to be seen by people and avert them from the way of Allah

and Allah is encompassing of what they do.

So, the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) came out with insolence and they came out to show off and to boast of their power and strength.

Rasool Allah ﷺ, now realizing that the caravan is trying to get away, and that instead of facing a caravan guarded by 40 men, they might be facing an army of 1000 strong.

Rasool Allah ﷺ held Shura(شورى) and he was asking the companions, What do you think?

So, Abu Bakr(ابوبكر) stood up and spoke, Umar Ibn Al-Khattabرضي الله عنه stood up and spoke.

And then Al-Miqdaad(المقداد) stood up and spoke and Abdullah Bin Masoodرضي الله عنه said that, Al-Miqdaad(المقداد) stood up and spoke some words,

I would sacrifice the world to be the one who spoke those words.

Al-Miqdaad(ألمقداد), he stood up and said; O Messenger of Allah, Go forth to what Allahعَزّوجَلّ has commanded you to do.

And we are not going to tell you, like the children of Israel(اسرائيل) told Musaعليه السّلام; Go and fight with your Lord, we're going to stay here.

But we will fight in front of you and behind you and on your right and to your left, and we will say, Go forth and fight with Your Lord, we will fight with you.

Rasool Allah ﷺ as it says in Al-Bukhari(اَلبُخَارِي), His face lit up, and it was shining, and he was happy, and he stood up.

So, those words of Al-Miqdaadرضي الله عنه strengthen the Sahabah(صحابه).

But that wasn't the case with all of them, not all of them had that idea on mind, see, because they didn't come out, prepared to fight a war.

The reason why, they came out of Madina was to raid a caravan, so they were lightly armed.

And mentally, they weren't prepared to face off an army.

So, some of them were reluctant, and inside their hearts, many of them wanted to raid the caravan.

They didn't really want to fight the army of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

So, Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; By the way, how do we know what's in the hearts of people?

See, that's the difference when we're dealing with history that is revealed in Qur'an, because Qur'an Allahعَزّوجَلّ knows what's in the hearts of people

Unlike a historian writing a book about history, he's going to go by what he sees, he doesn't really know what's in the insides of people in that particular era.

So, Allahعَزّوجَلّ tells us, it is just as when Your Lord brought you out of your home for the Battle of Badr(بدر) in truth.

While indeed the party among the believers were unwilling, Allahعَزّوجَلّ is telling us and we wouldn't have known otherwise.

Allahعَزّوجَلّ is telling us that some of the believers and by the way, here in the Battle of Badr(بدر), we're dealing with the cream of the crop, we're dealing with the best.

Even though some of them were unwilling.

Why? Because fighting is something disliked and here we're dealing with the first time, and there's some of them who maybe never met an enemy before.

And there's that fear that could occur in a person, when you're going to fight for the first time.

So Allahعَزّوجَلّ is saying, a party among the believers were unwilling, plus, fighting to start with Qitaal(قتال) is something disliked; "Fighting was prescribed on you, and you dislike it.

But then Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; but you might dislike something when it's good for you.

Allahعَزّوجَلّ then says; And then Allahعَزّوجَلّ says, Remember, O believers, when Allah promised you, one of the two groups that it would be yours,

one of the two groups meaning, either the caravan, or to defeat the enemy, and you wish that the unarmed one would be yours, people wanted the caravan.

And that caravan had the money of the Muhajireen(مهاجرين) in it, so they wanted it back.

But Allah intended to establish the truth by His words and to eliminate the disbelievers, that He should establish the truth and abolish falsehood, even if the criminals disliked it.

So, Allahعَزّوجَلّ, had a plan, while the people had a plan, and the plan of Allahعَزّوجَلّ was greater than that of the people.

The army of Rasool Allah ﷺ, some of them just wanted to raid that caravan and take over its wealth, while Allahعَزّوجَلّ wanted this battle to be the first meeting between good and evil,

and for it to be the day of Furqaan(فرقان), as we will see later on, it's the criterion.

Rasool Allah ﷺ was gathering intelligence about the whereabouts of the army of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) and also the whereabouts of the caravan, if they would be able to lay their hands on it.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ and Abu Bakr(ابوبكر), they met with this old Bedouin, this old man in the desert and Rasool Allah ﷺ asked him about the whereabouts of the army of Muhammadﷺ

and the whereabouts of the army of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

So, the man said: "Who do you belong to?" I'm not going to tell you until you tell me who you are.?

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ told him, if you tell us then we will tell you.

The old man said: This for that, Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Yes.

So, the man said, fine.

Muhammad(محمد) and his followers are at this place.

And if the person who told me is telling me the truth.

Now they would be in such and such place.

And he gave the right place of Muhammadﷺ and his army.

And then he said and the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) were in such and such place.

So, if the person who told me that is speaking the truth, now they would be in such and such place.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ here get some valuable information.

And he can trust it because the man gave the right location of the army of Muhammadﷺ, even though he didn't know that he was speaking to Muhammad(صلواة الله وسلام عليه).

So, that could be an indication that also the location that he's giving about the army of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) would be correct.

So, now the Bedouins turn to ask Muhammadﷺ, Who are you?

So, he says; Who are you?

Muhammadﷺ says; We are from water and then he walks away.

So, the old man is left to ask himself, What do you mean by water? Do you mean the water of Iraq?

Because the Arabs would name some people according to the name of their wells, or their water source.

So since, in Iraq you have rivers, Rasool Allah ﷺ when he said that we are from Ma'a(ماء) we are from water.

The man said: What do you mean by water? Do you mean the water of Iraq.?

And Rasool Allah ﷺ just walked away, so that the man weren't ask him, some more investigative questions.

What Rasool Allah ﷺ meant by that, was.?

We're from water.! That's what we're created from, and Allahعَزّوجَلّ says in Qur'an that man is created from water.

Rasool Allah ﷺ sends out Az-Zubair(أزبير) and Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) and some other Sahabah(صحابه) scouting, the area, trying to gather information.

So, they found a servant belonging to the army of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

They arrest him and take him back.

So, they brought him back while Rasool Allah ﷺ was praying.

And then they would ask him, Who do you belong to?

He would say, I belong to the army of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), so they would beat him up badly, and they would ask him about the location of Abu Sufiyan(ابوسفيان)

and this man doesn't know, he said I have no idea where Abu Sufiyan(ابوسفيان) is.?

So, they would tell him, Well, who do you know about.?

He said, I know the whereabouts of Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل), Ummayyah Bin Khalaf(امية بن خلف) of Ut'ba Bin Rabiyah(عتبة بن ربيعة), and he's naming some of the prominent members of the army of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

And they would beat him up and tell him where is Abu Sufiyan(ابوسفيان), so he say, okay, okay, I'll tell you about Abu Sufiyan(ابوسفيان).

So, they'll stop beating him and then they'll tell him where is Abu Sufiyan(ابو سفيان).?

He would say, I don't know.

Now, the reason, why they were beating him to give them the location of Abu Sufiyan(ابو سفيان) is.?

It shows you that they still wanted to know where the caravan is.!

And they weren't happy when he told them that I belong to the army of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

Rasool Allah ﷺ finished his Salah(صلاة) and told them, when he speaks the truth, you beat him.

And when he lies, you leave him alone.

So, when he would say yes, I know where Abu Sufiyan(ابو سفيان) is.

They would leave him alone.

And then Rasool Allah ﷺ went to interrogate him, himself.

Because Sahabah رضي الله عنهم weren't really getting right information from him.

So, now Rasool Allah ﷺ walks up to the man, without beating him.

He just asks him.

Tell me about the numbers.

What's the number of the army?

How many are they?

So, the young man says, I have no idea.

There are a lot, he'd say Katheer(كثير), they're a lot.

Rasool Allah ﷺ wants to get some specific information.

What does it mean a lot, Tell me how many they are?

And this young man has no clue.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ asks him, How many camels do they slaughter every day?

So, the man said, One day they would slaughter 10 camels the next day, they would slaughter nine.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; They are between 900 and 1000.

Rasool Allah ﷺ asked him about how much meat they're consuming daily, And then, what from that he know, what the number of the army is.

And he said they would be between Thousand and nine hundred and they were 950.

The army was 950 strong.

The cavalry was 200 strong.

They had 600 coat Males.

They had slave girls for entertainment, while the Muslim army was a little over 300.

So, it's one third the number of the army of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

Al-Muhajiroon(ألمهاجرون) numbered 86, Al-Aos(ألأوس) were 61 and Al-Khazraj(ألخزرج) were 170.

Now the reason, why the Aos(ألأوس) were fewer than Al-Khazraj(ألخزرج) Sixty one to 170.

Even though they are stronger and braver and as numerous as Al-Khazraj(ألخزرج) is because the dwellings of Al-Aos(ألأوس) were in the upper part of Madina

and Rasool Allah ﷺ when he mobilized his army, he said, you only join us, if you have you ride ready.

And because Al-Aos(ألأوس) were a bit far away.

They weren't able to join in this army. So, that's why their number were fewer than Al-Khazraj(ألخزرج), in this battle.

Al-Bara'a Bin Aazib رضي الله عنه, said; In Bukhari(البخاري).

Al-Bara'a Bin Aazib(ألبرآء بن عازب) said; we the companions of Rasool Allah ﷺ when we'd talk about the Battle of Badr(بدر), we would say; that the number of people who participated in the Battle of Badr(بدر)

is equal to the number of people, who participated with Talut(طالوت), after they passed the test, after they passed the trial of the river, and the only ones who passed, were the believers, who were a little over 310.

The fact that there is a correlation between the number of Muslims in the Battle of Badr(بدر) and the number of Bannu Israel(بنو إسرائيل) who participated with Talut(طالوت).

And the fact that Al-Bara'a(ألبرآء) here mentions that these are the ones who passed the tests and joined Talut(طالوت) tells you that the believers who are in the Battle of Badr(بدر) were also the best,

these were the ones who passed the fittan(فتن), and the trials of this world.

So, they are the best of the best.

The exact numbers some give, the number is 317, Some give it as 319. It's close to this range.

Rasool Allah ﷺ had banners, and that was his Sunnah(سنة) in every battle, flags the Muslims would have flags.

They also had slogans that they would, or battle cries, and this is all to encourage the soldiers to fight.

So, the banner was white, and it was given to Mus'ab Ibn Umair(مصعب إبن عمير).

And then he also had two black flags.

One of them was called Al-Uqaab(ألعقاب) and this was the standard that was carried by Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب).

And the other one was given to one of Al-Ansaar(الأنْصَار), so Al-Muhajiroon(ألمهاجرون) had a flag and Al-Ansaar(ألأنصار) had a flag and both of them were black.

And then the army had a white flag and that was carried by  Mus'ab Ibn Umair(مصعب إبن عمير).

The entire army had only two horses.

One was for Az-Zubair(ألزبير) and the other one Al-Miqdaad Ibn Amr(ألمقداد إبن عمرو), and they had 70 camels.

And we mentioned that every three would take turns on one camel.

Rasool Allah ﷺ had Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) and Abu Lubabah(أبو لبابه) with him.

And then he said; If I live long enough to eat these dates, it would be a long life.

He was so inspired by the words of Rasool Allah ﷺ, he was in such a hurry to die in the path of Allahعَزّوجَلّ, that he considered it, too long of a life,

to even finish the dates in his hand and he rushed into the fray of battle.

That is how inspired they were, based on the words of Mao'idha(مؤعظة), of reminder that they were hearing from Rasool Allah ﷺ.

Rasool Allah ﷺ in the Battle Of Badr(بدر), actually let me go carry on from some of the scenes that we're talking about.

We'll mention the death of Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل).

Another important scene is what happened to Ummayyah Bin Khalaf(امية بن خلف).

Sa'ad Ibn Muadh(سعد ابن معاذ) said that I was friends with Ummayyah Bin Khalaf(امية بن خلف), and when he would visit Madina, he would stay with me and when I would visit Makkah, I would stay with him.

So, Sa'ad Ibn Muadh(سعد ابن معاذ) say that I visited Makkah and I stayed with Ummayyah Bin Khalaf(امية بن خلف), after Rasool Allah ﷺ has made Hijrah(هجرة) to Madina.

So, I told him, I want you to find me a time, when it's not crowded, so that I can make Tawaf(طواف) around Al-Ka'aba(اَلْكَعْبَه).

They went out to make Tawaf(طواف) and Abu Jahal(ابوجهل) sees Sa'ad Ibn Muadh(سعد ابن معاذ).

So, he asks Ummayyah Bin Khalaf(امية بن خلف), Who is this.?

He said, this is Sa'ad Ibn Muadh(سعد ابن معاذ), Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل), he said, I see that you are safe in Makkah.

When you have given refuge to As-Subaa(ألصباء), this is a derogatory term that they would use against the Muslims.

And you claim that you're going to support them and give them victory and protect them.

If It wasn't that you are with Ummayyah(اُمَيَّه) with Abu Safwaan(ابوصفوان), I would have killed you.

Sa'ad Ibn Muadh(سعد ابن معاذ) responds back, his voice was loud.

He said; If you do that, I'll do something that is worse for you.

I will prevent your caravans from passing through Madina.

So, Madina control the lifeline of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), the route between Makkah and the Ash-Sham(ألشام).

Ummayyah Bin Khalaf(اُمَيَّة بِنْ خَلَف) told Sa'ad Ibn Muadh(سعدابن معاذ), don't speak like that with Abul Hakam(أبو الحكم), because he's the chief of this valley.

So, Sa'ad Ibn Muadh(سعد ابن معاذ) said: Let's not talk about this no more.

Plus, I've heard Rasool Allah ﷺ say that they're going to kill you.

Ummayyah Bin Khalaf(اُمَيَّة بِنْ خَلَف) said; They're going to kill me?

He said; Yes.

Did he say if they're going to kill me in Makkah, or outside Makkah, Sa'ad(سعد) said; I don't know.

Ummayyah Bin Khalaf(اُمَيَّة بِنْ خَلَف) went back to his home and he told his wife.

Do you know what my friend from Madina told me.

She said, what?

He said, that Muhammad(محمد) promised his followers that he's gonna kill me.

She said, Did he tell you where.?

He said: No, I asked him whether it's in Makkah or outside Makkah.

And he said he doesn't know.

But I'm never going to leave Makkah then.

Subhaan Allah(سُبْحَان الله), they would accuse Rasool Allah ﷺ of being a liar, but then they would believe everything that he would say.

So, it shows you that deep inside their hearts, they knew that he was Rasool Allah ﷺ, They are rejecting the message, even though they believe that it is certainly true in their hearts.

So, Ummayyah Bin Khalaf(اُميَّة بن خلف) says; I'm not going to leave Makkah.

Now, when the call came to respond to the Battle of Badr(بدر).

Ummayyah(اُمَيَّة) didn't want to leave.

So, Abu Jahal(ابو جَهَل) brings him, a Mubkhara(مبخره), Mubkhara(مبخره) is this thing in which they burn inside it, the Ood(عود).

So, he brought it to him and told them; Take it, because you're an old woman, so use this as old women do.

Abu Jahal(ابوجَهَل) was insulting him and telling him that you're such a coward, you're going to stay behind with the women.

Ummayyah(اُمَيَّة) was obviously insulted, and Abu Jahal(ابوجهل) kept on trying, until he was able to convince Ummayyah Bin Khalaf(اُميَّة بن خلف) to go out with them.

Ummayyah(اُمَيَّة) went back home preparing to leave.

His wife told him; Didn't you remember what your friend from Madina told you?

He said; Yes, I do.

But I'm just going to go, so far with them, then I'm going to come back.

Ibn Kathir(اِبْنِ كَثِيْر) said that whenever they would stop, he would make the intentions that the next stop would be, the last stop until he ended up entering the fray of the battle, himself.

So, Ummayyah(اُمَيَّة) ended up being captured by Abdur-Rahman Ibn Auf(عبدألرحمن إبن عوف).

How did it happen?

Abdur-Rahman Ibn Auf(عبدألرحمن إبن عوف) is narrating the story himself.

He said: I had a bunch of coat males with me, armor.

And these are pretty expensive, and he has collected them one by one, as booty.

And then Ummayyah(اُمَيَّة) sees him and says, O Abd Amr(عبدعمرو), Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن) said:  I didn't respond.

See! Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن) and Ummayyah(اُمَيَّة) were friends in Makkah.

And the name of Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن) was Abd Amr(عبدعمرو), when he became Muslim, he changed his name to Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن).

Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن) said: when Ummayyah(اُمَيَّة) would call me, Abd Amr(عبدعمرو), I wouldn't respond.

So, Ummayyah(اُمَيَّة) told him, when I call you Abd Amr(عبدعمرو) you refused to respond back.

And I do not recognize, Ar-Rahman(ألرحمن), so I cannot call you Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن).

So, how about you choose for yourself a name, just for me and you.

So, Abdur-Rahman Ibn Auf(عبدألرحمن إبن عوف) said; Well you go ahead and choose the name.

He said, I'll call you Abdul Illah(عبداله), the servant of God.

So they agreed.

So, whenever Ummayyah(اُمَيَّة) would meet Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن), he would say, Abdul Illah(عبداله), because the Mushriqeen(مشركين) of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) did not recognize, Ar-Rahman(ألرحمن).

That's in one narration, in another narration it says that Abdur-Rahman Ibn Auf(عبدألرحمن إبن عوف) said that I had an agreement with Ummayyah Bin Khalaf(اُمَيَّة بِنْ خَلَف) that I will take care of his business interests

and this is in Bukhari(بخاريْ), I'll take care of his business interest in Madina, while he'll take care of my business interests in Makkah.

Abdur-Rahman(عبدألرحمن إبن عوف) said: I didn't respond back to Ummayyah(اُمَيَّة), when he said Abd Amr(عبدعمرو) and then he said, Abdul Illah(عبداله),

so I responded back to him, and he said, Do you want something better for you than those coat males that you're carrying?" Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن) said: What is it?

He said: Me and my son.

Obviously, Ummayyah(اُمَيَّة) is rich, so his ransom will fetch a lot of money.

Same with his son, Ali(علي).

So Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن) said: I threw the armor from my hand, and I held Ummayyah(اُمَيَّه), and his son Ali(علي), in both of my hands.

So now, they are his prisoners of war.

And he's the one who's holding them.

Therefore, he is the one who will get the ransom since according to the tradition, if you are the one who capture somebody, you get the ransom for him.

So, it was a better deal for Abdur-Rahman Ibn Auf(عبدألرحمن إبن عوف) However, someone spots Ummayyah Bin Khalaf(اُمَيَّة بِنْ خَلَف) and who was it?

Bilal(بلال), Bilal Bin Rabah(بلال بن رباح), the former slave of Ummayyah(اُمَيَّة), the one, who was tortured by Ummayyah(اُمَيَّة), and the story of the torture of Bilal(بلال) is famous, you all know it.

So Bilal Bin Rabah(بلال بن رباح), when he sees Abdur-Rahman Ibn Auf(ألرحمن إبن عوف), he said; Ummayyah(اُمَيَّة), the head of the disbelievers.

Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن) said; Hey, Bilal(بلال)! He is my prisoner.

Bilal(بلال) says; I will not live, if he does.

Abdur-Rahman Bin Auf(عبد ألرحمن إبن عوف) said; Listen Bilal(بلال), he is my prisoner.

Bilal(بلال), when he realizes that Abdur-Rahman(عبدالرحمن) is not willing to give him up.

Bilal(بلال) goes to some of the Ansaar(أنْصَار) and tells them that man is Ummayyah Bin Khalaf(اُمَيَّة بِنْ خَلَف), Ra'as-Ul-Kuffr(رأس الكفر)

That man is Ummayyah(اُمَيَّة), the head of the disbelievers.

I'm not gonna live, if he does.

Abdur-Rahman Bin Auf(عبد ألرحمن إبن عوف) said: "So they pounced on us, they attacked.

Now he said they enclosed us and I felt that I wouldn't be able to defend them.

So, what I did is I released Ali(علي), to get them busy with him.

And then I told Ummayyah(اُمَيَّة) to run with me.

So, they attacked Ali(علي) and they killed him, they cut them into pieces.

And I was telling Ummayyah(اُمَيَّة) to run but he was a heavy man, so they ended up catching up with us.

So, I told him to lay down, and then I jumped over him, to protect him with my own body.

He said, so the swords of the Ansaar(أنْصَار) were digging deep under me tearing him apart.

In fact, one of them even injured me in my foot.

And the narrator of this Hadith(حديث) would say; Abdur Rahman(عبدالرحمن) would show us the scar that was left, by the swords of the Sahabah.

Abdur-Rahman Bin Auf(عبد ألرحمن إبن عوف) would then say, may Allah Have mercy on Bilal(بلال), He made me lose my armor and lose my prisoners, I lost them both.

So, this is what happened with Ummayyah Bin Khalaf(اُمَيَّة بِنْ خَلَف) who is, as Bilal(بلال) said; He was an Imam(اِمَام) of disbelief.

Anas Ibn Malikرضي الله عنه tells us the story of Al-Qaleeb(ألقليب).

He says; The Messenger of Allah ordered on the day of the battle at Badr(بدر), that 24 of the chiefs of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) be thrown into a dirty refuse laden old Well.

So, the bodies of the leaders of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), Twenty four of them were dragged into this grave.

It was a dirty, refuse laden old well as Anas Ibn Malik(اَنَس اِبْن مالك) describes it.

When they were pulling the body of Ut'ba Bin Rabiyah(عتبة بن ربيعة).

His son Hudhaifa(حذيفه) was watching on.

So Rasool Allah ﷺ, looks into his face and sees that he was distressed, he was sad.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ said: Abu Hudhaifah(أبو حذيفه), are you very upset at your father's fate?

So, Abu Hudhaifah(أبو حذيفه) responds back, I swear, O Messenger of Allah. I have no problems with my father's fate.

But I once knew him as a man of reason, judgment and goodness and hope those qualities would lead him to Islam.

When I saw, what his fate was and how he had died in disbelief, despite my hopes for him, I was saddened.

Rasool Allah ﷺ then made Dua(دُعَا) for him.

Dear brothers and sisters, The issue of guidance is something in the hands of Allah, nobody can control it.

Here Abu Hudhaifah(أبو حذيفه) is saying that my father was wise, he was a man of reason.

He was a man of judgment, he was a man of goodness, and I hope that these qualities would guide him to Islam.

But things didn't turn out, as he expected.

And that is the case with Abu Talib(ابو طالب) also, Abu Talib(ابو طالب) the uncle of Rasool Allah ﷺ carried these same qualities.

In fact, he protected Rasool Allah ﷺ for the entire period he spent in Makkah, until he passed away, and Abu Talib(ابو طالب) never became Muslim.

So, when it comes to the issue of guidance, you can't really tell who will be guided and who won't.

While Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب), who is so evil in his torture of Muslims, he becomes Muslim, and we talked about the story of Islam that

when one of the Muslims saw that one of the Sahabiaat(صحابيات) was expecting Umar(عُمَر) to become Muslim, because he spoke to her softly.

He responded back by saying the donkey of his father would become a Muslim before he does.

Meaning take that idea out of your mind such a person can never become Muslim, but he did.

And he became one of the best Muslims.

So the issue of who is guided and who isn't is something that we cannot control.

And we cannot even expect.

Don't make a judgment on a person and say O, he might become Muslim, and O, he might not become Muslim.

You know, at the end, Abu Talib(ابو طالب) dies as a Kafir(كافر) and Abu Sufiyan(ابوسفيان) dies as a Muslim.

Abu Talib(ابو طالب), who supports Rasool Allahﷺ for all of his life ends up going to Hellfire.

While Abu Sufiyan(ابوسفيان), who fights Rasool Allah ﷺ for most of his life ends up becoming Muslim.

So, such issues should be left in the hands of Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

And that's why, Rasool Allah ﷺ says, You don't guide the ones you want, the ones you love, the ones you like, but it is Allah who guides, the ones He wants.

This is a matter of Qadar( قدر) of Allahعَزّوجَلّ and we'll leave it in His hands.

So, Abu Hudhaifah(أبو حذيفه) here was kind of upset and sad because his father didn't become Muslim.

It also shows you, our loyalty should go to Allah entirely.

And even though Abu Hudhaifah(أبوحذيفه) was sad that his father died as a disbeliever But that didn't make him forsake his religion, or blame someone or blame something

that my father didn't become Muslim.

He accepted it and he said, O Messenger of Allah, I have no problems with my father's fate, I accept it.

I accept that this is from Allahعَزّوجَلّ, I accept it.

And this is called; You're content with what Allahعَزّوجَلّ gives you and what happens to you.

And I'm saying this because we've known brothers and sisters in the West, who have embraced Islam but their parents didn't.

And they are very eager to have their parents become Muslim, and they are giving them Da'wah(دعوة).

I just want to say that you do your best in Da'wah(دعوة) but then leave the issue of Hidayah(هدايه), in the hands of Allah and don't become overwhelmed or upset, if they don't die as Muslim

and accepted as the Qadar(قدر) of Allahعَزّوجَل.

And if they do become Muslim, then give credit to Allahعَزّوجَلّ and leave it in his hands and say, Al-Hamdolillah(إلحمدلله) that Allahعَزّوجَلّ has guided them to His religion.

Rasool Allah ﷺ tried very hard with his uncle, but it didn't work.

While people from distant lands would come to him like Salman  Farsi(سلمان فارسي), and Abu Dhar(أبو زر).

We asked Allahعَزّوجَلّ to guide us to the truth.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ ordered that the bodies of 24 of the chiefs of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) be thrown into this well.

Rasool Allah ﷺ, it was his habit that he would stay at the site of the battle for three days, before he would leave.

When he was about to leave from the site of the Battle of Badr(بدر).

He visited the Qulaib(قليب), this Well in which the 24 leaders of Kuffr(كفر) were buried.

And he was speaking to them, He said; Would you now, be pleased to have obeyed Allah and His messenger?

We have found that what our Lord promised us was true.

Have you found what your Lord promised you to be true?

Umar Ibn Al-Khattabرضي الله عنه said; O, Messenger of Allah, why do you speak to bodies that have no spirits in them?

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: by Him, Who holds the soul of Muhammad(محمد) in His hand, You do not hear, what I say any better than they do.

And this is in Bukhari(بخاريْ), so Allahعَزّوجَلّ made them hear, what Rasool Allah ﷺ was telling them.

And this is to add to their punishment.
